subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Jack learned that an empty page may look clean, but it cannot teach much.”?
options: A used page, even a messy one, can show that learning happened.
Even a tone, a pause, or a laugh may belong to someone.
At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.
It looked messy, but it showed the life of the class.

optionRationales.reason: 本文可直接核對「Jack learned that an empty page may look clean, but it cannot teach much. A used page, even a messy one, can…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Even a tone, a pause, or a laugh may belong to someone.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It looked messy, but it showed the life of the class.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Jack learned that an empty page may look clean, but it cannot teach much. A used page, even a messy one, can show that…」，答案為「A used page, even a messy one, can show that learning happened.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A used page, even a messy one, can show that learning happened.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
